name: Preventive maintenance plan
summary: For one site, the facilities or operations manager gets every piece of equipment ranked by failure cost, an approach for each (run to failure, scheduled or condition-based), a dated calendar of tasks from the maker's guidance and the failure history, the spare parts to hold and the downtime measures to track.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work and the form of this one: the manager's files as the only authority, with set column headings and a stop on a mismatch; failure cost with the sum shown and cost bands; intervals never lengthened and never changed on safety-critical equipment, and shortened only on repeated failures of one part; a dated calendar with overdue and unrecorded tasks flagged; spare-part minimums and shortfalls for approval, never ordered; measures with a baseline and no target; every gap written as a decision for a named role; and a section for the competent person, with no engineering sign-off given.

sources.contribution: Grouping equipment by how much a failure matters, with a risk to safety in the top group, and fitting the kind of maintenance to each group; a breakdown's cost as time stopped plus repair; the maker's figures where the record is thin; mean time between failures and mean time to repair as measures; spares sized from use during the supplier's lead time; a schedule grouped by how often tasks recur.
